Official Early Access FAQ: starting areas
stat_facts: Increases health and reduces chance to be dazed in combat (wiki Statistics; '1 STA = 1 HP' is marked 'need testing' there).
Increases melee and ranged weapon damage and shield block amounts; 1 STR = 2 weight (wiki Statistics).
Increases hit rate, weapon proc frequency and gives a channeling bonus to spellcasters (wiki Statistics).
Mana pool size if INT is higher than WIS, and offensive spell damage (wiki Statistics).
Mana pool size if WIS is higher than INT, and healing done; 4 mana per WIS point for WIS-based classes (wiki Statistics).
Merchant prices and charm break rate on paper; the wiki notes CHA did not seem to affect vendor prices in beta (May 2026).
class_mod: +1 STR, +3 DEX, +2 AGI, +2 WIS (wiki Ranger Creation Guide)

mana.text: Your mana stat is whichever of INT or WIS is higher (wiki Statistics); 13 of 103 wiki Ranger spells cost mana.
mana.label: FACT

builds.name: Dual-wield and bow (default)
builds.why: Rangers use a bow and dual blades (official). DEX for hit rate and procs, STR for weapon damage, AGI for off-tanking.

builds.name: Outdoor utility
builds.why: For most playable races WIS is at least as high as INT, so it is your mana stat for snares and travel spells (see the mana note for your race).

builds.name: Off-tank
builds.why: The official page says Rangers can off-tank with limited aggro control.

build_caveat: Point totals are from the wiki race pages (10 bonus points for every listed race/class). Whether a stat has a per-point cap or diminishing returns at creation is not documented on the wiki: UNVERIFIED.

traits.why: Dexterous: +5% DEX and a 15-second +50% DEX burst.
Bowman: Archery at 5 (+25%), a Trainee's Longbow, Hip Quiver and 1000 arrows. Swordsman if you open in melee.
Forage is not available to Rangers (they draw food from nature as a class ability, official). Infravision or Ultravision helps in caves at night; pick one your race may take.

race_pick.Deep Elf: Ultravision (Infravision is not available to your race)
race_pick.Human: Slow Metabolism (Infravision is not available to your race)

traits.why: Tracker (Ranger, Druid, Bard only) starts Tracking at 25 and raises it 25% faster; Rangers can track creatures (official). Miner for coin.

trait_caveat: Trait text and race/class limits are from Template:Traits; picks that your race cannot take are swapped automatically in the race note. Which trait is 'best' is STRATEGY; no sourced numbers compare them.

why.mining: Gathering for coin; pairs with the Miner trait (this Codex's default set).
why.smelting: Turns ore into sellable bars (separate skill on the wiki).
why.lumberjacking: Second gathering skill for coin, part of the default set.
why.fletching: Make your own arrows instead of buying them.

tradeskills.note: Gathering defaults plus Fletching for arrows. Smithing stays off. STRATEGY.
